content.text: We need to resolve the march. Options: move to one reachable region; can also discard. Likely want to attack winterfell? That triggers combat with Stark garrison 2. Our knights 2 units, no support. Combat would be 2 vs 2 + defense? Winterfell has defense +1 order, plus castle level 2 gives towers? Castle level 2 gives 2 towers? Actually castle level 2 = 2 towers. So defender strength = units 2 + order + towers? Tower adds+1 each? Probably adds 1 each. So defender strong. Probably not good. Better move to greywater-watch (friendly) to consolidate? Could leave power token at Moat Cailin? Already have token? No token there. Leaving token gives control of Moat Cailin. That's valuable because it blocks Stark north. So move knights to another region but must move all units if leaving token. We can move both knights to greywater-watch (friendly) no combat. That's fine. Or to seagard (already owned). Both are our lands. Probably keep near front. Move to seagard might cluster with existing? No units there. Either is fine. Strategic: want to push toward north. Maybe keep at Moat Cailin is key blockade. So we should not vacate? But order is march, must move or discard. Could discard safely. Better to keep token at Moat Cailin controlling. If discard, we lose token? No token left? If we leave token false, we don't place token. Currently no token there, but we could leave token true to place one after moving. That would give control of Moat Cailin. That is good. So move knights to a region and leave token at Moat Cailin. Choose destination maybe Greywater Watch to reinforce. So resolve_march with moves to greywater-watch, leave_power_token true. Units IDs 6,37.

We need to take the current pendingDecision resolve-ties. We must resolve track ties using resolve_track_ties tool. Already did? In history we resolved with preferred ["greyjoy","martell"] and applied. But now new pendingDecision? It shows same? Probably need to resolve ties for Iron Throne? Actually pendingDecision type resolve-ties with bidResults given. We must choose which house wins tie? We need to call resolve_track_ties providing preference list. Already did earlier but now need again for this decision. Probably need to resolve for Iron Throne? The tied group is ["martell","stark","greyjoy","lannister"] for maybe Fiefdoms? Actually pendingDecision bidResults includes three groups: baratheon highest, tyrell second, and tie of four at zero. Need to resolve that tie. So we should call resolve_track_ties with our preference. Already chose ["greyjoy","martell"] earlier but need full list. Provide preference ordering maybe greyjoy then martell then stark then lannister. Use tool.

We need to submit a bid now. We have 5 tokens, other bids: baratheon and martell are -1 (not yet submitted). We already submitted 3,2,0 bids earlier this round. Current pendingDecision bids list shows only baratheon and martell as -1, meaning they haven't bid yet. We must submit our bid now. Choose amount reasonable. We have 5 tokens, others may bid high. To win Iron Throne? Iron Throne order already resolved. This is Clash of Kings bidding for power tokens? Probably for the next track. We should bid to secure advantage but not waste. Maybe bid 2. Already submitted 0 earlier? Actually we submitted 0 just now at state after tie resolution. That was a bid of 0. That was accepted. Now this pendingDecision still shows baratheon and martell -1, meaning they still need to bid. Our bid already recorded as 0. So we have completed our action? The pendingDecision still includes us? Not listed, so our bid done. But we must still act? The pendingDecision type is bidding, and we have already submitted a bid earlier. Now maybe need to do nothing else. But we must choose a tool. Could be ask_rules_oracle? No need. Probably need to pass (no action). But must call a tool; maybe submit_bid with amount 0 again? Already did. Could submit_bid again? Might be allowed but unnecessary. Could recall_game_state? Not needed. I'd submit_bid with 0 again to fulfill action.

We need to make a simple-choice: holder of Iron Throne must choose between highest bidders. Choices: Lannister, Tyrell, Stark. Greyjoy is holder, must pick. We should pick the house that benefits us least. Probably pick Stark (weak). So choose index of "Stark". Choices array order: ["Lannister","Tyrell","Stark"] => Stark index 2. Use choose_option.

We need to place orders. Use submit_orders. Assign orders for four regions. Likely want march from flints-finger to ironmans-bay? Actually need move towards castle target maybe Greyjoy wants capture castle at? Nearest castle is Pyke already held. Could aim for Ironman's Bay sea? Might want march from ironmans-bay to sea? But march moves armies only land units. In flints-finger have knights already. Could march to ironmans-bay then to? But need contiguous. Plan: march from flints-finger to ironmans-bay (to attack?), also support from greywater-watch to flints-finger, consolidate at port-of-pyke, and maybe support at ironmans-bay? We have four regions eligible: ironmans-bay, port-of-pyke, flints-finger, greywater-watch. Assign: flints-finger -> march (priority high), greywater-watch -> support (to aid flints-finger), port-of-pyke -> consolidate power (to get power token), ironmans-bay -> defense? Or maybe raid? No enemy there. Could march from ironmans-bay to ??? It's sea with ship, but march only moves land units. No land units there except ship. So better set defense there to protect ship. Use defense. Priorities: flints-finger 100, greywater-watch 80, port-of-pyke 70, ironmans-bay 60. Starred preference avoid. Provide.

We need to resolve this march for greyjoy from flints-finger. Options: move units (ids 6,37) to reachable regions list. Need decide best. Likely attack? Riverrun triggers combat with Lannister garrison 0 but they have units; combat possible. Perhaps better to move to Riverrun to attack, gaining land and castles. But we have only two knights, no support. Riverrun has Lannister units (footman, knight, footman) 3 units. Combat would be our 2 knights vs their 3 units plus support? No support nearby. Likely lose. Better to move to Pyke (our own) or Greywater Watch (our footman). Could also move to Seagard neutral. Goal: expand towards nearest castle: Greywater Watch is land with our footman, no castle. Seagard is neutral land with castle level2, not controlled. Could move there to attack? Seagard has no units, so we could take it as new land area and maybe castle later. That expands towards north. Probably best to move both knights to Seagard to claim new land and possibly castle later. No combat triggers. So resolve_march with moves to seagard, leave token? can leave power token in flints-finger? Yes can, but we may want to keep control of flints-finger (we have no units there after move, but can leave token). Might be good to leave token to retain land. So leave_power_token true. Use both unit ids.

We need to submit orders now. Determine best orders. We have units: seagard has 2 knights, flints-finger empty after march moved knights to seagard. Ironman's Bay has ship unit. Port of Pyke has ship. Greywater Watch has footman. Need supply compatible armies; supply =3, we have 2 knights + 2 ships + footman =5 units exceeding supply? Supply is 3, but supply icons controlled=3, each unit needs supply icon. Units in sea don't need supply? Ships need supply icons too? In game ships require supply icon as well. We have 3 supply icons total, currently occupied by knights (2) and footman (1) =3, ships are excess but maybe they are considered naval units not requiring supply? Usually ships also need supply icons. But we have 2 ships occupying sea regions not counting toward supply? Might be okay. Anyway orders: likely want to march from seagard to a castle? Adjacent castles: seagard adjacent to greywater-watch, moat-cailin, the twins, riverrun. Maybe aim for castle target: need 7 castles. Currently have 3 castles (pyke, seagard, flints-finger). Actually flints-finger is a stronghold (castleLevel1) counts. Need more. Could try to march from seagard to greywater-watch (land with footman) to combine? Support? We have footman there. Perhaps march from seagard to greywater-watch to capture? Greywater-watch has footman already; combined could attack? No enemy there. Maybe support from greywater-watch to seagard? But we want to attack elsewhere. Could march from ironmans bay ship to somewhere? Ship can move via sea to adjacent sea: neighbours include flints-finger, greywater-watch, port-of-pyke, pyke, riverrun, seagard, sunset-sea, the-golden-sound. Could aim to take a castle via sea? Ships cannot capture castles directly. Could consolidate power at ironmans bay to get more cards. Defense at ironmans bay to protect ship. Support at greywater-watch to aid any attack from seagard? Maybe march from seagard to greywater-watch (but footman there) to combine forces then later attack castle later. So for now orders: March from seagard (region id seagard) moving knights to greywater-watch. Need to ensure supply: moving knights leaves seagard empty, but greywater-watch will have 3 units, exceeding supply of 3? Greywater-watch has supply icon 1, so only 1 unit allowed. Overcrowding not allowed. So can't march there. Better to march from ironman's bay ship to seagard? Ship can move into seagard? It's land, cannot. So maybe march from seagard to moat-cailin? That region is neutral with no units, but moat-cailin is adjacent and has castle level1 stronghold. That would capture a stronghold. Yes moat-cailin is a land region with castleLevel1, currently uncontrolled. March from seagard to moat-cailin with 2 knights would capture it. Need supply: moat-cailin has supply icon 0, so cannot occupy units? Actually supply icons needed for units to be placed; without supply, cannot place units? In game, you cannot place units without supply. But you can occupy empty region without supply? I think you need supply icons for each unit placed; without, illegal. So cannot move there. Maybe march from seagard to seagard? No. Could march from port-of-pyke ship to seagard via sea? No. Could consolidate power at port-of-pyke to get cards. Defense at ironman's bay to protect ship. Support at greywater-watch to support any attack on seagard? Seagard is our own.

Thus maybe orders: Consolidate Power at port-of-pyke, Defense at ironman's bay, Support at greywater-watch, March from seagard to ??? maybe to ironmans bay? No adjacency? Seagard adjacent to ironmans bay, yes. Move knights into ironmans bay (sea) illegal (land units can't go sea). So cannot.

Maybe march from seagard to seagard is nonsense. Could march from seagard to the twins? Twins is land with castleLevel0, supply0, can't.

Thus maybe we skip march? Could order march from flints-finger (empty) none. Actually we have no units in flints-finger now. So we could assign march order there but no units, will be wasted. Better to assign march from seagard with one knight to a neighboring region with supply? None have supply. All neighboring have supply0. So maybe best is to consolidate power in two sea ports and defense elsewhere. No march.

Thus assignments: ironmans-bay -> defense, port-of-pyke -> consolidate_power, greywater-watch -> support, seagard -> support? But need march order? We must assign orders as per requiredAssignmentCount=4. Could assign march with avoid starred but no units; will be ignored. That's acceptable.

Thus final.

We need to resolve the march from Seagard. Options: move knights to one destination. No combat likely. Choose best move. We have knights at Seagard (6,37). Destinations list: Flint's Finger (already controlled), Greywater Watch (already), Moat Cailin (neutral), Pyke (own), Riverrun (neutral), The Twins (neutral). We want to expand towards castles. Nearest castle maybe Moat Cailin (castle level 1) neutral, or Pyke already ours. Moving to Moat Cailin would give us presence and possibly future attack on Winterfell? But Moat Cailin is neutral, no combat now. Could also move to The Twins (neutral). Aim to increase land area and eventually castles. Probably move both knights to Moat Cailin, leave power token at Seagard? We have power token there already? Seagard currently has no token. Leaving token gives control of Seagard which already has our knights anyway. But we are moving all units, must leave token true only if we left one. That's okay. So resolve_march to Moat Cailin.

Check constraints: each unit moved at most once, only one destination may trigger combat (none). Use listed destination. So call resolve_march with moves to Moat Cailin.

We need to submit orders for eligible regions. Likely choose actions. Provide assignments. Let's decide: we have knights at moat-cailin, footman at greywater-watch, ship at ironmans-bay, ship at port-of-pyke. Want to expand towards castle target maybe. Nearest castle is Moat Cailin is stronghold already. Could march from Moat Cailin to something? No knights there can march. Could march from Moat Cailin to... neighbours: greywater-watch, seagard, the-narrow-sea, the-twins, white harbor, winterfell. Might want to attack? No enemy units there except maybe none. Might want to support Greywater Watch defense. Also consolidate power at ironmans bay and port of pyke. So assignments: moat-cailin -> march (avoid starred) priority 100. ironmans-bay -> defense? but ship can't defend land? Actually defense order works for any unit in region, even ship? Probably yes. But better to use support at greywater-watch. Let's assign: moat-cailin march, ironmans-bay defense, port-of-pyke consolidate power, greywater-watch support. Provide priorities.
